description: Hermes gateway service down on macOS host; recover via launchd using host access. GOMS state untouched.

steps.description: Capture failing-state evidence: gateway service status and recent stderr log
command: launchctl list | grep -i hermes; tail -30 "$HOME/.hermes/profiles/gsvaineko/logs/gateway.error.log" 2>/dev/null || true

steps.description: Kickstart the gsvaineko gateway launchd job
Verify gateway service is listed again
Verify profile data intact (state.json + authority audit present)
